description.narrative:
Urbanization is a major global trend that is transforming the way people live and work around the world. However, urban policies are not yet effective to ensure positive impact on people’s lives, therefore the need to advocate on urbanization issues. The WUC aims to influence urban policies and advocate for sustainable urban development at local, national, and global levels by engaging with urban stakeholders, advocating for policy changes, and promoting international agendas such as the New Urban Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals.
The WUC 2.0 Programme will draw on the World Urban Campaign (1.0) implementation since its inception in 2009 as a merger of the two UN-Habitat global campaigns on secure tenure and good urban governance (1997-2008). The WUC will continue to engage partners through a participatory mechanism to ensure buy-in and contributions by partners of the WUC at various levels.
Under the United Nations Decade of Action, the WUC will mobilize national and sub-national organizations, cities and communities, to exchange on urban solutions and promote urban impact in Urban Thinkers Campus and other events, and share lessons learned in the WUC Academy, to better implement the SDGs and the New Urban Agenda.
Through consultation, the WUC will determine the most effective tactics and tools to be used to achieve the campaign's objectives. The campaign will use strong data and clear measurable targets for each thematic track of the campaign. The campaign will also use strategic influencers, who can demonstrate change from their perspectives as leaders, innovators, urban thinkers and change-makers to promote areas of catalytic actions. The campaign will promote urban solutions and policies and increase the engagement of government, non-government and private sector entities on sustainable urbanization and the implementation of the New Urban Agenda. The WUC will generate a range of solutions and recommendations to influence urban policies that positively impact people’s lives.
Resource Mobilization will increase through a grounded sponsorship approach to attract new private sector and foundations partners to support specific actions and gain a special visibility in WUC events and promotional campaigns. The WUC proposes a resource mobilization mechanism to benefit feasibility studies (City Investment Facility), city project, expert publications and learning activities, as well as impact advocacy to show case impacts.
The WUC will also put in place a mechanism for partners’ reporting on the results of the UTCs and solutions collected, regularly evaluate the campaign's effectiveness and make adjustments based on feedback and results.
